messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing-metering-service error rate spike detected for invoice-generation pipeline. error ratio 12% over last 10m. paging SRE-Oncall and billing-oncall.
Maria Chen: seeing it in the ops dashboard too — invoices stuck in 'generating' for a subset of customers, UI shows 0 usage for some orgs.
Ajay Patel: confirmed. backend job logs show repeated 5xx when writing usage summary to ledger-db. sample log: `ERR writeLedger: pq: duplicate key value violates unique constraint` — looks like reconciliation job id collision.
Elena Rodriguez: is this impacting invoices already sent or only preview/dashboard?
Julian Park: both. A small number of invoices were marked paid but amounts are 0 in the UI. We have 7 customer reports so far (internal tags).
Noah (product-ops): need to coordinate customer comms. Quick question: do we have a status page update ready?
Support Bot: queue: #support-tickets shows three open for revenue-critical customers. ticket refs: SUP-4231, SUP-4234, SUP-4239.
SRE-Oncall: assigning to Ajay, Maria on mitigation. I'll triage and start a mitigation runbook.
Ajay Patel: mitigation plan: 1) stop invoice-generation cron (so we don't emit more bad invoices) 2) flush write buffer and re-run reconciliation with de-dup flag 3) fix job id allocation in next patch. Starting step 1 now: `kubectl scale deployment invoice-cron -n billing --replicas=0`
Maria Chen: running a targeted cache clear for affected orgs: `POST /internal/cache/flush` payload with orgs list. initiating.
incident-bot: INVESTIGATION: root cause suspected: race in reconciliation job id allocation after recent deploy (eng-runtime v2.4.1).
Elena Rodriguez: drafting status page text — short and transparent. Draft: "We are investigating an issue affecting invoice previews and usage display for a subset of customers. Some invoices may show incorrect usage values or be delayed. No payment processing risk identified so far. Engineers are investigating and mitigation is in progress." Thoughts?
Noah (product-ops): tweak: call out ETA for next update (30 mins) and link to support contact. Also include mitigation steps taken.
Maria Chen: re-run reconciliation for affected orgs in dry-run mode first: `python3 tools/reconcile.py --orgs @affected --dry-run --dedupe` — dry-run shows corrected values for 28 invoices.
Julian Park: good sign. schedule re-run without dry-run when we confirm.
Support Bot: drafted a customer notification (template) for triaged customers: 
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We’re investigating an issue where usage previews and invoices may display incorrect usage totals. Our engineers are actively addressing this and we will follow up with corrected invoices if needed. There is no action required from you at this time.
We expect an update within 30 minutes. If you have immediate concerns, reply to this thread or contact support@redwood.ai.
— Redwood Inference Support
```
Ajay Patel: switching off conflicting job id allocator and applying hotfix `git checkout -b fix/job-id-collision && git apply patch.diff && deployctl promote billing-worker` — deploying to canary now.
incident-bot: DEPLOY: billing-worker canary deployed to us-east-1 (deploy-18233). Monitor for error rate drop.
SRE-Oncall: I've wired a short-lived metric alert for ledger write errors to 1m. watching.
Maria Chen: after hotfix, ledger 5xx rate dropped to baseline. dry-run and sample re-run look good. preparing full re-run: `python3 tools/reconcile.py --orgs @affected --dedupe` (estimated 12m).
Elena Rodriguez: status page update ready to publish. Proposed content:
```
Incident: Incorrect invoice/usage display for subset of customers
Current status: Investigating → Mitigating
Impact: Affected customers may see zero or incorrect usage in invoice previews and UI. A small set of invoices generated during the event may have incorrect amounts displayed. Payment processing not impacted.
Action taken: Stopped invoice generation pipeline, applied a hotfix to job id allocator, re-ran reconciliation for affected accounts.
Next update: in 30 minutes or when root cause is confirmed.
```
Noah (product-ops): go ahead and publish. I'll coordinate customer-specific follow-ups for top-tier customers.
Support Bot: posting templated customer notifications to the triaged ticket list now.
Billing Team: flagged list of customers who received invoices in the 04:00–04:12 UTC window. sending CSV to ops channel.
Ajay Patel: full reconciliation completed. re-checking integrity: `SELECT count(*) FROM invoices WHERE audited = false` returned 0. sample cross-checks look clean.
Julian Park: rolling invoice-preview UI cache back to normal; CDN purge in progress.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: System metrics show stable error rate, reconciliation completed, UI values corrected for affected customers. Please confirm if there are remaining customer escalations.
Support Bot: SUP-4234 still open (customer asked for corrected invoice PDF). assigned to Maria.
Maria Chen: sending corrected PDFs and apology note for SUP-4234. also scheduling a follow-up email to the affected cohort with remediation summary.
Elena Rodriguez: internal comms template for post-incident summary (for leadership):
```
Summary: Brief description of incident (timeline, impact).
Scope: number of customers affected, business-critical customers impacted.
Root cause: job id allocation race introduced in v2.4.1 leading to duplicate ledger keys and partial invoice generation.
Mitigation: stopped pipeline, hotfix deployed to billing-worker canary then prod, reconciliation re-run, cache purges, customer notifications sent.
Action items: backfill missing telemetry, add end-to-end test for job id uniqueness, release retrospective and postmortem within 48h.
Customer impact: list + corrective steps.
```
SRE-Oncall: handing off to Julian for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. oncall shift ends in 10m.
Julian Park: ack — will own the postmortem and timeline collection. I’ll also coordinate with Billing Team for reconciliation audit.
Noah (product-ops): I'll prepare the status page final update marking "Resolved" once Billing Team confirms no outstanding mismatches.
Billing Team: audit confirm: all affected invoices corrected and reissued where necessary. CSV reconciliation attached in billing channel.
incident-bot: THREAD SUMMARY: incident resolved — root cause identified and fixed, customer notifications sent, postmortem assigned to Julian Park.
Maria Chen: quick note — retrospective items: 1) add a guard in reconciliation to detect duplicate keys before write 2) surface invoice-preview vs ledger divergence alert earlier 3) extend retention on invoice generation logs for 72h.
Julian Park: will include those in the action-items section. target postmortem deadline: 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC.
Noah (product-ops): thanks everyone. good fast collaboration.
Support Bot: closing support tickets related to this incident after confirmation emails are sent.
Maria Chen: closing thread but will append follow-ups to the postmortem doc.
